147-1893-2292.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-2292.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-7316--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-7316--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

222-527-4247-7730.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-7730.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

5968-5972-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5968-5972-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5968-5972-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-3723-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1745-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
1745-6034-8089.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1309-1987-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1309-1987-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2146-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3055-3953-4050-7699.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dread Drone, adding {W}.
When Dread Drone dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Dread Drone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dread Drone enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Dread Drone.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

851-2457-4289-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-3334-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Lae'zel and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

891-4775-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3756-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3756-4231-4772.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3532-5078-7010-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7010-7328.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2921-7198.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

1879-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1879-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

5170-6132-6794-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1753-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5223-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

6754-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4549-5051-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4549-5051-5078-6650.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Traxos, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

631-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Grim Haruspex.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Cryptic Trilobite from your library.
Repeat.

643-851-3951-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-851-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

3967-4826-5222-6644.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

703-4394-4875-5231.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

224-1174-1257.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
224-1174-1257.notablePrerequisites: Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
224-1174-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Walking Atlas.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

2018-2438-4053.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
2018-2438-4053.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature without flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2018-2438-4053.notes: If you wish to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder, instead do not resolve its abilities, and then remove Solemnity from the battlefield. Then, resolve the abilities to get the +1/+1 counters.

1545-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1545-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

3750-5988.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls five or more artifacts.
3750-5988.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent that controls five or more artifacts using Cavern-Hoard Dragon.
Cavern-Hoard Dragon triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat until no opponent controls five or more artifacts.

890-2410-4273.notablePrerequisites:
Copy Artifact  is a copy of Myr Galvanizer.
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
890-2410-4273.description:
Activate either Myr Galvanizer or Copy Artifact by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-2079-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-2079-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

712-4289-4824.notablePrerequisites: Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
712-4289-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Wake Thrasher triggers, causing it to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

290-1183-4853.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
290-1183-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-3129.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Primal Vigor
Repeat.

3789-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3789-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3789-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
